name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-13, at wavelengths from 1.15 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
